ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows the raised-cosine spectrum curve of the total characteristic H(ω) of the baseband system; the curve reaches the maximum value 1 at ω=0; in the positive-frequency direction, a dashed line marks that the amplitude at ω=π/T is 1/2; the positive-frequency support range of the curve extends to ω=2π/T and then drops to 0. Reasoning: Taking the positive-frequency cutoff angular frequency ω_c=2π/T in the figure as the baseband bandwidth, then B=ω_c/(2π)=(2π/T)/(2π)=1/T Hz. The symbol interval is denoted as T, so the maximum symbol rate without ISI is Rs=1/T Baud. The maximum bandwidth efficiency is Rs/B=(1/T)/(1/T)=1 Baud/Hz.

raw_record.question_text: The total characteristic of a baseband transmission system is given as the raised cosine characteristic shown in the image. Find the maximum bandwidth efficiency of the system without ISI, in Baud/Hz.

method.method_draft: First describe the graph as a raised-cosine spectrum with positive frequency support ending at omega=2pi/T. Treat this positive cutoff as the baseband bandwidth: B=(2pi/T)/(2pi)=1/T Hz. The symbol interval in the notation is T, so the maximum no-ISI baud rate is Rs=1/T. Compute efficiency Rs/B=(1/T)/(1/T)=1 Baud/Hz.

method.method_draft: Describe the diagram as a raised-cosine response whose positive zero crossing is labelled 2pi/T. Compare this with the standard raised-cosine edge omega=(1+alpha)pi/T, giving alpha=1. Then use the Nyquist raised-cosine bandwidth formula B=(1+alpha)/(2T)=1/T Hz and Rs=1/T. Therefore the maximum bandwidth efficiency is Rs/B=2/(1+alpha)=1 Baud/Hz.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中给出基带系统总特性 H(ω) 的升余弦形响应，曲线关于 ω=0 对称；在 ω=0 处幅度为 1；虚线显示在 ω=π/T 处幅度为 1/2；正频率侧零交点标为 2π/T。推理：标准升余弦特性的正边缘角频率为 (1+α)π/T。由图中零交点 2π/T 可得 (1+α)π/T=2π/T，因此 α=1。无 ISI 时升余弦带宽 B=(1+α)/(2T)=1/T Hz，符号率 Rs=1/T Baud，所以最大带宽效率为 Rs/B=(1/T)/(1/T)=1 Baud/Hz。
